groups.name: capture
groups.summary: Capture the game view, the Scene view or a six-angle surround sheet to PNG, with an optional inlined image.

actions.name: game
actions.summary: Capture what a camera renders. Add --include-ui for the overlay-composited game view image.

actions.name: scene-view
actions.summary: Render the Scene view camera on demand and restore its render target afterwards.

actions.name: multiview
actions.summary: Frame the subject from six axis directions (surround), one PNG per angle.

actions.name: list
actions.summary: List the images this session produced, plus capture folders under Assets/Docs~.

outputFolder.description: Project-relative folder under Assets/. Default Assets/Docs~.

filename.description: Bare file name for a single capture; must not contain a path.

prefix.description: File name prefix when no filename is given.

force.description: Overwrite an existing file instead of failing with ASSET_EXISTS.

target.description: Camera name or instance id. Defaults to Camera.main, then the first enabled non-Scene-view camera.

includeUI.description: game: composite the overlay UI too. Requires Play Mode and waits for the end of a frame.

includeImage.description: Inline a base64 PNG in the response.

maxResolution.description: Cap applied before an image is inlined.

batch.description: multiview: orbit is not implemented and reports so.

targetObject.description: multiview: object whose bounds frame the shots. Defaults to all enabled renderers.

distance.description: multiview: camera distance as a multiple of the subject radius.
